C0838.title: Weak Passwords Lead to Unauthorized Access of 20 Million Personal Records
C0838.summary: Shaanxi police uncovered a case of illegal acquisition of citizen personal information. A criminal gang exploited weak passwords—such as company abbreviations and legal representative name initials—to breach enterprise system accounts, unlawfully obtaining approximately 20 million personal records and profiting over 6 million yuan.
